## The original series will begin airing in January 2027
...
A brand-new trailer was released today for the Inherit the Winds anime's two-week theatrical preview run, which will commence in November 13 before the series debuts next January. As previewed in the trailer, "Namida no Kawa" by Hitsujibungaku and Quruli will serve as the theatrical preview's theme song, as well as the series' ending theme song. The pair will also perform "Kaze wo Tsugu Mono" for the series' opening theme song. Furthermore, Takaya Kamikawa joins the cast as Shinbei Umeda, a retainer of the Iwakuni Domain.

## Inherit the Winds Anime Advance Theatrical Screening Trailer
...
The Inherit the Winds TV anime is inspired by the first story in the popular Tachikawa Jinsuke stage play tetralogy performed by the theatre group Caramel Box since 1996. Set in the time around the Meiji Restoration, the series follows the fictional Shinsengumi soldier Jinsuke Tachikawa (voiced by Daisuke Sakuma) as he lives in a rapidly changing Japan. Inherit the Winds introduces Tachikawa as he enters the war and deals with the ramifications of the Kinmon incident. The stories are penned by playwrights Yutaka Narui and Azuki Mashiba. Tomohiro Kawamura directs the anime adaptation at Live2d Creative Studio and Drive Inc., with scripts by Yutaka Narui, character designs by Fumi Ebina and music by Shigeru Kishiba. The series will begin airing sometime in January 2027.

# Oishinbo Cooking Manga Receives New TV Anime Series
...
Tetsu Kariya and Akira Hanasaki’s long-running Oishinbo cooking manga series is receiving a new TV anime adaptation titled Shin Oishinbo. The new anime project was announced during a stage event at ABEMA Anime Festival 2026 celebrating Shin-Ei Animation’s 50th anniversary.
...
The Oishinbo manga series, which is written by Kariya and drawn by Hanasaki, has been serialized in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Spirits magazine since October 1983. It has been in an indefinite hiatus since May 2014. A total of 111 tankobon volumes have been published in Japan as of December 2014.

cbr.com/zach-cregger-joker-batman-movie.title: Resident Evil Director Wrote a Batman Script With an Unusual Twist
cbr.com/zach-cregger-joker-batman-movie.excerpt:
Filmmaker Zach Cregger has another big hit on his hands with the successful launch of Resident Evil. Amid the new film's success, fans may be wondering how his Batman movie would have turned out if it had gotten made.
...
During a new interview for Men's Health, Cregger shared details about Henchman, his screenplay for a film set in Gotham City. It came with a unique twist, as while characters like Batman and The Joker were present, they were not the focus. The film would have instead focused on an everyman who happens to get caught up in a conflict between the Dark Knight and the Clown Prince of Crime. This is reminiscent of the new Resident Evil following a courier who stumbles into Raccoon City right when the zombie outbreak from the games begins, rather than using a powerful and established character.
...
“It’s about a normal guy," Cregger said of the script, which was the first movie screenplay he ever wrote. "It’s about a pharmacist who lives in Gotham City, and he gets accidentally sucked into this incredible power play between Batman and The Joker. And he finds himself a very integral part of something. And so, it’s a weird movie. It’s someone living on the periphery of all the stories in Gotham that we know of, and it’s about some rando. I’m not the world’s biggest Batman guy at all, but I just liked this story. I liked this character. I liked what happened to him, so it was just fun.”
...
Most comic book movies focus on popular superheroes, although some will shift the focus to villains, with characters like The Joker and Clayface getting their own movies. What's very uncommon is for a movie based on DC or Marvel comic books to keep the focus on a "normal guy" and turning the superheroes and supervillains into side characters. As the movie was not made and Cregger has moved on to other projects, it seems improbable that Henchman will ever see the light of day, though the director's fans can imagine how it might have turned out.
...
Cregger turned things around in a big way with the success of the horror flick Barbarian, his first feature film as a sole director. Last year's Weapons was a huge hit for Cregger as well, leading to his hiring to direct a new Resident Evil movie. This was a move that is working out well for Sony, as Resident Evil is now being declared as the greatest video game movie of all time.

...
In a newly released interview for the art book The Art of Solo Leveling, Chugong recalls some of the struggles he faced while serializing the original web novel series. Although he had the ending to Jinwoo’s story mapped out before he began writing, Chugong still ran into complications along the way. At one point, he even had to put the series on an extended hiatus to get everything organized ahead of the finale.
...
As Chugong fleshed out Solo Leveling's story chapter by chapter, he began to struggle to reconcile the new version of Jinwoo’s story with his original vision for how it would end. While the series' world-building and background lore remained steadfast, Chugong decided to remove details he felt didn’t serve the main storyline (such as the concept of the Itarim) in order to focus purely on Jinwoo’s main story arc.
...
Ultimately, this process proved difficult, especially given the rather unforgiving writing schedule for a serialized webnovel. "I remember that the story became tangled during that process of adding and removing elements," Chugong recalls, "forcing me to place the series on hiatus for a while." While he never shares exactly when this hiatus took place, there’s at least one likely period he's referring to.
...
According to Kakaopage's announcement archive, Chugong took a week-long break in early July 2017, just before the series’ final arc. It was likely during this short break that Chugong's aforementioned hiatus took place as he sought to connect all the dots ahead of the release of Chapter 233.

bleedingcool.com/tv/lanterns-has-picked-.excerpt:
Grant Morrison posted an update on HBO's Lanterns, praising Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre and noting that the series "has picked up nicely."
...
With the first of the season's final three episodes hitting tonight, Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King's Aaron Pierre (John Stewart) and Kyle Chandler (Hal Jordan)-starring Lanterns is winning over a whole lot of naysayers with each chapter, and that includes writer and comics great Grant Morrison. Things got off to a bit of a rocky start when Morrison called out Lindelof for a joke the latter made during a podcast about why the show wasn't called "Green Lanterns." That was followed by a less-than-stellar rundown of the series premiere by Morrison, shortly after it debuted. But now, after five episodes and the final run ahead of us, Morrison's views on the show have evolved since the August premiere.
...
In the latest edition of their Substack Xanaduum ("A Tree Made of Sparks"), Morrison shared that they're liking what they're seeing from Chandler and Pierre, and their takes on Hal Jordan and John Stewart, respectively. Though not exactly thrilled with how Ulrich Thomsen's Sinestro is being utilized ("the Hannibal Lectering of Sinestro"), Morrison noted that they're sticking with it until the end – just don't expect to hear much more from Morrison about Lanterns between now and then.
...
"Lanterns. Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre are great. I didn't care for the Hannibal Lectering of Sinestro, but otherwise the show has picked up nicely and the approach has worked, so good on them," Morrison wrote. "Otherwise, I've grown to love the more nuanced Hal Jordan Kyle Chandler is delivering, while Pierre's John Stewart has developed impressively as a character, with every episode cracking him out of his regimented shell while Hal's reckless drunken bum routine is revealed as useful misdirection. I'll watch until the end, but it's probably not worth having any more opinions about the show until then. So shove that up your green ring, clickbait creators!"

To say that filmmaker Mike Flanagan is no stranger to bestselling author Stephen King's literary universe would be an understatement, to say the least. Look no further than his upcoming series take on King's classic 1974 novel Carrie, with buzz growing over Flanagan's unique vision and willingness to take some amazing creative swings. But when it comes to King, Flanagan's biggest challenge still lies ahead: his, Trevor Macy, and Intrepid Pictures' television series and film adaptation of "The Dark Tower" universe. Not only is King's fantasy-adventure-horror series epic in and of itself, but it also serves as the connective core to all of King's works. Yeah, it's big. The good news? Flanagan says the adaptation is still "very much on the table," but there have been some speed bumps along the way.
...
"To do it the way I wanna do it requires an enormous commitment from a studio," Flanagan shared with EW during an interview in support of Carrie. While Flanagan's move to Amazon after a successful creative run at Netflix didn't make matters any easier, an "enormous commitment" that Flanagan references has to do with locking down rights to certain King characters. "The way the Dark Tower universe is connected, you've got characters in there that are all over the place when it comes to studio ownership. So the development process on it has been epic. # 『ふつつかな悪女ではございますが』第2クールは来年1月放送 新キャストに中村悠一、土岐隼一、小林千晃 

 メインビジュアル、キャラクタービジュアルも公開 テレビアニメ『ふつつかな悪女ではございますが～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～』の第2クールが、2027年1月より放送されることが発表された。あわせて、キャラクターデザイン・菊池愛氏による描き下ろしのメインビジュアルも公開。新キャラクターの声を、中村悠一、土岐隼一、小林千晃が演じることが明らかになった。 

テレビアニメ『ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～』新メインビジュアル（C）中村颯希・一迅社／「ふつつかな悪女」製作委員会 

写真ページを見る

【画像】イケメン増えた!新たに登場する『ふつつかな悪女』キャラクタービジュアル

 ビジュアルは第1クールと対称的に描かれており、本作の中心人物である玲琳と慧月、莉莉や冬雪に加え、第2クールより登場する黄景行（こうけいこう）、黄景彰（こうけいしょう）、雲嵐（うんらん）が登場。第1クールとは異なり雛宮の外に出て進行する物語を想像させる仕上がりになっている。 さらに、第11話に登場した新キャラクターのキャラクタービジュアルも公開。景行役を中村、景彰役を土岐、雲嵐役を小林が務める。 また、第1クールの劇伴を収録したオリジナル・サウンドトラックがきょう21日より各音楽配信サービスにて配信開始された。 

テレビアニメ『ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～』サウンドトラック配信（C）中村颯希・一迅社／「ふつつかな悪女」製作委員会 

 本作は、中村颯希氏とイラスト・ゆき哉氏による一迅社ノベルスにて刊行中の小説が原作。尾羊英氏によるコミカライズが『月刊コミック ZERO-SUM』にて連載中で、小説は「シーモアみんなが選ぶ2023 電子コミック大賞」ラノベ部門賞を受賞、「ブックライブ年間ランキング2023」女性向けラノベランキング1位。コミカライズは「マガデミー賞2023 作品賞ノミネート助演女優賞ノミネート」朱慧月、「楽天Kobo電子書籍アワード2024／今読んでおきたい！注目コミック部門」を受賞している。 物語は、聡明で美しく誰からも愛されていて、「殿下の胡蝶（こちょう）」と呼ばれている黄玲琳と、劣等感が強く、卑劣な言動から悪女と呼ばれ皆から嫌われている朱慧月。そんな正反対の少女2人が繰り広げる後宮“入れ替わり”逆転劇となる。 ■新キャストコメント ▼中村悠一（黄 景行役） 

中村悠一 

この度参加させていただきます中村悠一です。本作はたくさんのキャラクターが出てきつつも、どれもこれも個性的で、魅力に溢れています。負けないように頑張りました！そして！ポップな雰囲気もありつつ追い詰めていくような緊迫感や物語の展開の妙に、引き込まれること間違いありません。ぜひこれから先も楽しみにしてくださいませ！ 

黄 景行（C）中村颯希・一迅社／「ふつつかな悪女」製作委員会 

▼土岐隼一（黄 景彰役） 

土岐隼一 

黄景彰の声を担当させていただきます土岐隼一です。黄家はかなり豪胆な血筋のようで、それぞれに性格の違いはあれど心に1本の芯が通った力強さを彼にも感じています。主人公2人の物語をさらに素敵に彩れるよう、全力で演じました。よろしくお願いいたします！ 

黄 景彰（C）中村颯希

▼小林千晃（雲嵐役） 

この度、雲嵐の声を担当させていただきます。小林千晃です。雲嵐は、南領・温蘇の邑で次期頭領と目される一方、何か目的があって暗躍をしている謎の多い人物です。しかしその目の奥には並々ならぬ覚悟が秘められているので、彼がどんな想いを抱えて朱慧月や黄玲琳と関わっていくのか、ぜひ放送を楽しみにお待ちください！雲嵐の生き様を表現できるよう、全力で臨ませていただきます。よろしくお願いします！

# ICv2: Marvel Announces 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man' Season 2 Miniseries
...
ICv2: Marvel Announces 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man' Season 2 Miniseries

Tie-In Ahead of Season 2 of Disney+ Series

Posted by Brigid Alverson on September 21, 2026 @ 12:46 pm CT

 

Marvel will publish a four-issue miniseries tying in with the Disney+ show Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man, set between the first season of the show, which launched in January 2025, and the second, which will launch in January 2027. The miniseries will reunite the creative team of writer Christos Gage and artist Eric Gapstur, who wrote a five-issue prequel before the show premiered (see “ Prequel Comic”). Like the first one, the new miniseries will be tied into the show’s continuity. “Just like last time, showrunner Jeff Trammell has been incredibly generous about coordinating in a way that makes our story a firm part of the show's continuity,” Gage said in a statement accompanying the announcement, adding, “It's a real pleasure to be a part of this take on Spidey that combines the feel of the Silver Age with new and exciting characters and situations. I hope I get to do it again next year!”
...
The first issue of Season 2 of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man will go on sale on December 9, 2026, with covers by Leonardo Romero, Luciano Vecchio, and David Baldeón.

highlights: Announced at Shin‑Ei Animation’s 50th anniversary stage event during ABEMA Anime Festival 2026
Teaser videos for the new Oishinbo TV anime were released
The adaptation will be produced by studio Shin‑Ei Animation, which handled the original 1988‑1992 series
The manga, created by Tetsu Kariya and Akira Hanasaki, has sold over 135 million copies worldwide
oishinbo_tv_anime_2026_announce.why_it_matters: Reviving a beloved classic introduces its culinary storytelling to a new generation of viewers.

katekyo_hitman_reborn_anime_reveals_twel.headline: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume"
katekyo_hitman_reborn_anime_reveals_twel.summary: The anime’s twelfth ending video, creditless and set to Mori Tsubasa’s "Aoi Yume," was released as part of the series’ 20th‑anniversary music project.
highlights: The creditless ending video was released on September 20, 2026, marking the latest entry in the REBORN! MUSIC MONTH campaign
"Aoi Yume" was the ending theme for episodes 140‑153 of the series
The video is now available on the official REBORN! YouTube channel, having previously only appeared on physical releases
Studio Artland produced the original anime, which streams on Crunchyroll
katekyo_hitman_reborn_anime_reveals_twel.why_it_matters: It gives fans online access to a previously physical‑only ending sequence, celebrating the franchise’s 20‑year milestone.

tensei_goblin_dakedo_shitsumon_aru_annou.headline: Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? Announces Supporting Cast
tensei_goblin_dakedo_shitsumon_aru_annou.summary: The TV anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki's manga will premiere on October 5, 2026 and has revealed a lineup of supporting voice actors.
highlights: Junko Takeuchi, Mariya Ise, and Rin Mizuki are among the announced supporting cast
The series is directed by Ryouta Kawahara and produced by studio Bakkka
It will air at 10:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, with subsequent broadcasts on BS11, Sun TV, and AT-X
tensei_goblin_dakedo_shitsumon_aru_annou.why_it_matters: The announced cast adds notable talent and raises anticipation for the upcoming fantasy series.

conan_the_barbarian_s_savage_stories_are.headline: The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8
conan_the_barbarian_s_savage_stories_are.summary: Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept.
highlights: Collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) issues #102‑116 and Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35
Over 1,000 pages of digitally remastered artwork with bonus material and rare artwork
Features a new introduction by Gary Kwapisz and a never‑before‑reprinted adaptation by Big John Buscema
Suggested retail price is $150
conan_the_barbarian_s_savage_stories_are.why_it_matters: Provides the first comprehensive, high‑quality collection of late‑era Conan stories, completing the omnibus series for collectors.

bleedingcool.com/comics/rebellion-offici.headline: Why the Zenith Omnibus Is a Milestone for 2000 AD

bushiroad_ghost_meets_gal_anime_youtube_.headline: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Ghost Meets Gal Mini Anime
bushiroad_ghost_meets_gal_anime_youtube_.summary: Bushiroad released the three‑episode mini‑anime adaptation of the Ghost Meets Gal spin‑off manga on its Cardfight!!
highlights: The mini‑anime debuted on September 5, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. JST with Japanese audio and English subtitles
Produced by studio AtoriE and features voice work by Karin Kagami and Yūka Nishio
Theme song "Nikoichi Mirai" performed by BanG Dream!’s Mugendai Mewtype band
All three episodes were uploaded to the official Cardfight!! Vanguard YouTube channel
bushiroad_ghost_meets_gal_anime_youtube_.why_it_matters: It adds a new short‑form entry to the long‑running Cardfight!! Vanguard franchise, boosting its multimedia presence.

world_webtoon_awards_announces_finalists.headline: 2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote
world_webtoon_awards_announces_finalists.summary: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and KOCCA revealed the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards and opened worldwide voting.
highlights: 20 finalists were announced, including titles like Lookism, Omniscient Reader and The Greatest Estate Developer
Global online voting runs from September 17 to October 19, with judges' scores and reader votes each counting for 50%
Cash prizes are introduced for the first time, with the grand prize worth 15 million won (~US$10,700)
The awards ceremony is scheduled for December 3 at the Starfield Library in Seoul as part of the World Webtoon Festival
world_webtoon_awards_announces_finalists.why_it_matters: The event highlights the growing international influence of webtoons and offers creators significant monetary recognition.

tetsury_meet_tetsud_musume_anime_s_new_p.headline: Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume
tetsury_meet_tetsud_musume_anime_s_new_p.summary: A new trailer for the anime previewed the opening theme “GO!
highlights: The opening theme is performed by Asaka
The series will debut on October 8 on Tokyo MX and BS Fuji and stream worldwide via HIDIVE
Directed by Misuzu Hoshino at East Fish Studio with scripts by Aya Satsuki
The franchise celebrated its 20th anniversary in 2025
tetsury_meet_tetsud_musume_anime_s_new_p.why_it_matters: The series expands the long‑running Tetsudō Musume franchise as it marks its 20th‑year milestone.

bleach_calamity_event.headline: Bleach Fes.
bleach_calamity_event.summary: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War announced a two‑day stage event in Japan for February 27‑28, 2027, to celebrate the anime’s finale.
highlights: The event, titled Bleach Fes., will be held on February 27 and 28, 2027 in Japan
Voice‑cast members will appear on stage
The festival is positioned to commemorate the conclusion of the Thousand‑Year Blood War anime and its legacy
Organizers hinted the event could be used to reveal future franchise plans
bleach_calamity_event.why_it_matters: It provides fans a live celebration and a potential platform for new Bleach announcements after the series wraps up.

mha_ultra_expo_2027.headline: My Hero Academia Ultra Expo 2027
mha_ultra_expo_2027.summary: The My Hero Academia 10th anniversary project will culminate in the two‑day Ultra Expo held on April 17‑18, 2027 at Makuhari Messe, Chiba.
highlights: The event is scheduled for April 17‑18, 2027 at Makuhari Messe’s Exhibition Halls 2 & 3 and Event Hall
Organizers describe it as the largest My Hero Academia event ever
An official website and X account have been launched, with full program details to be released in early October 2026
mha_ultra_expo_2027.why_it_matters: It marks the finale of the anime’s decade‑long run and offers fans a major live celebration of the franchise’s legacy.

the_detective_is_already_dead_anime_unve.headline: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2
the_detective_is_already_dead_anime_unve.summary: The second season of The Detective Is Already Dead will stream on Crunchyroll starting October 7, 2026.
highlights: 5th anniversary visual released to mark the series’ five‑year milestone
Manabu Kurihara returns as director with series composition by Deko Akao
Character designs by Yosuke Ito and music by 40mP and Yuyu
Season 2 will debut on October 7, 2026 on Crunchyroll
the_detective_is_already_dead_anime_unve.why_it_matters: The continuation confirms the series’ ongoing popularity and expands its mystery narrative for fans.

the_reincarnated_elf_left_a_journey_mast.headline: The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic
the_reincarnated_elf_left_a_journey_mast.summary: The TV anime adaptation of Monshō Sakakibara's light novel will premiere in January 2027, with the first two minutes of episode 1 released online.
highlights: First two minutes of episode 1 were streamed on the official website
Premier set for January 2027 on Sunday
Directed and scripted by Yuki Inaba at Studio Palette
Stars Daiki Yamashita as Liese and Hana Hishikawa as Minori
the_reincarnated_elf_left_a_journey_mast.why_it_matters: It marks the debut of a new isekai series with a notable staff and cast, expanding the genre’s 2027 lineup.

oishinbo_adaptation_2026.headline: Oishinbo
oishinbo_adaptation_2026.summary: The long-running Oishinbo cooking manga will receive a new TV anime adaptation titled Shin Oishinbo.
highlights: Announced at the ABEMA Anime Festival 2026 celebrating Shin‑Ei Animation’s 50th anniversary
The project is titled Shin Oishinbo and will revive the classic food‑themed series
No premiere date, cast, staff, or animation studio has been confirmed yet
oishinbo_adaptation_2026.why_it_matters: It marks the return of a seminal culinary series after more than three decades since its original TV run.

legendary_isekai_2026_reboot_trailer.headline: Magic Knight Rayearth
legendary_isekai_2026_reboot_trailer.summary: A reboot of CLAMP’s classic Isekai anime Magic Knight Rayearth will premiere on October 7, 2026, streaming exclusively on Crunchyroll.
highlights: The new series will run for two consecutive cours, ending around March 2027
Opening theme “Otome no Ken” by Toaka and ending theme “Seira” by Yurina Kawaguchi were revealed
New cast members include Mamiko Noto, Ayumu Murasa, Hitomi Ueda, and Hiroki Yasumoto
Directed by Yui Miura with production by Kadokawa and TMS Entertainment
legendary_isekai_2026_reboot_trailer.why_it_matters: The reboot revives a seminal Isekai franchise for a new generation after 31 years.

spider_avengers_crossover_special.headline: Marvel’s Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team‑Up!
spider_avengers_crossover_special.summary: A Halloween‑themed crossover special featuring Spider‑Man and the Avengers will debut on Disney+ in fall 2026.
highlights: The special pairs Spider‑Man from “Spidey and his Amazing Friends” with Iron Man and his Awesome Friends
Voice cast includes Alkaio Thiele, Mason Blomberg, Armen Taylor, Hero Hunter, Patrick Stump, and Este Haim
It follows a second team‑up special slated for October 16 2026, both produced by Disney Jr. and Marvel Studios
The Halloween special is part of Disney+’s weekly release slate for September 21‑27, 2026
spider_avengers_crossover_special.why_it_matters: It expands Marvel’s preschool‑friendly lineup, offering a seasonal crossover that can attract both existing fans and new young viewers.

disney_is_making_a_controversial_change_.headline: Disney+ Adds Commercials to All Subscription Tiers
disney_is_making_a_controversial_change_.summary: Disney+ will allow promotional content, commercials, and sponsorships before, after, and during programs across every tier, including the ad‑free premium level.
highlights: The change applies to all Disney+ subscription tiers, even the premium ad‑free plan
Promotional content may run before, after, and during live events and programs
The update was noted in Disney+ terms of service by gaming blogger Game With Dave
Fans may downgrade to lower tiers if ads appear in premium service
disney_is_making_a_controversial_change_.why_it_matters: Introducing ads to the premium tier could drive subscriber churn and reshape expectations for streaming services versus traditional cable.

my_hero_academia_anniversary_event.headline: My Hero Academia Ultra Expo
my_hero_academia_anniversary_event.summary: My Hero Academia will hold a two‑day Ultra Expo in Japan on April 7‑8 2027 to celebrate the franchise’s 10th anniversary.
highlights: The Ultra Expo was announced during a livestream with voice cast members
It will take place on April 7‑8 2027 in Japan, billed as the largest event in the series’ history
The event caps off a year of new anime releases, including an epilogue episode and a short set after the TV series
my_hero_academia_anniversary_event.why_it_matters: The expo highlights ongoing franchise activity despite the anime’s conclusion, offering fans new experiences and potential future content.

harley_quinn_preview_ivy_uproots_their_r.headline: Harley Quinn #66
harley_quinn_preview_ivy_uproots_their_r.summary: Harley Quinn #66 arrives in stores on September 23, 2026, featuring a showdown with Poison Ivy’s prehistoric plant attack on Throatcutter Hill.
highlights: Harley Quinn #66 hits stores on Wednesday, September 23, 2026
The issue pits Harley against Poison Ivy’s botanical chaos threatening Gotham
Creative team includes writer Elliott Kalan and artist Carlos Olivares
Cover variants feature work by David Nakayama, Terry Dodson, Rachel Dodson, Derrick Chew, and Mattia De Iulis
harley_quinn_preview_ivy_uproots_their_r.why_it_matters: The issue deepens the Harley‑Ivy romance while delivering a visually striking plant‑based threat to Gotham.

spider_man_hulk_fire_and_brimstone_previ.headline: Spider-Man/Hulk: Fire and Brimstone #2
spider_man_hulk_fire_and_brimstone_previ.summary: Spider-Man/Hulk: Fire and Brimstone #2 hits stores on September 23, 2026, featuring Bruce Banner’s spiritual quest and a team‑up with Daredevil against White Rabbit.
highlights: Bruce Banner seeks salvation in a church before the Hulk emerges
Spider-Man teams with Daredevil to stop White Rabbit’s Broadway disaster
The issue is written by Kevin Smith, Andy McElfresh, and R.B. Silva and will be available September 23, 2026
Multiple variant covers are offered, including Alex Ross and Greg Land editions
spider_man_hulk_fire_and_brimstone_previ.why_it_matters: The issue blends superhero action with a unique religious theme, expanding the Spider-Man/Hulk crossover narrative.

major_crunchyroll_isekai_reveals_new_loo.headline: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2
major_crunchyroll_isekai_reveals_new_loo.summary: The second season of the Isekai anime A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
highlights: Season 2 premieres on September 26, 2026 via Crunchyroll
Directed by Yuya Horiuchi with scripts by Kazuyuki Fudeyasu at studio Wao World
New opening theme “Melodic Impact” by Suspended 4th and ending theme “Yurete Skirt” by Chakara
Expanded voice cast includes Akio Otsuka, Atsushi Miyauchi, and Shuhei Sakaguchi
major_crunchyroll_isekai_reveals_new_loo.why_it_matters: The continuation adds fresh battles and characters to a standout Isekai series, attracting fans of the genre.

solo_leveling_continue_jinwoo_s_story_it.headline: Solo Leveling: Beyond the System
solo_leveling_continue_jinwoo_s_story_it.summary: A theatrical movie continuing the Solo Leveling anime after season 2 has been announced.
highlights: Announced at Crunchyroll Showcase during Anime Expo 2026
Co-produced by Crunchyroll, Aniplex, Netmarble, D&C Media and Kakao Piccoma
Animation production by A-1 Pictures, the studio behind the anime series
solo_leveling_continue_jinwoo_s_story_it.why_it_matters: It expands the popular Solo Leveling franchise with its first feature‑film, promising new story content for fans of the series.

times_scarlet_witch_her_role_marvel_s_so.headline: Scarlet Witch Crowned New Sorcerer Supreme
times_scarlet_witch_her_role_marvel_s_so.summary: Marvel officially announced Wanda Maximoff as the new Sorcerer Supreme in the upcoming "Sorcerer Supreme" comic series.
highlights: Wanda Maximoff assumes the mantle of Sorcerer Supreme, succeeding Victor Von Doom
The new series launches in December 2025 on Marvel.com
Her powers now draw from primordial Chaos Magic granted by the eldritch god Cthon
times_scarlet_witch_her_role_marvel_s_so.why_it_matters: Her ascension reshapes the magical hierarchy of the Marvel Universe and sets up fresh story possibilities.

years_later_major_crunchyroll_anime_fina.headline: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian Season 2
years_later_major_crunchyroll_anime_fina.summary: The romance anime’s second season has been confirmed for a 2027 release after a delay from its original 2026 schedule.
highlights: A trailer for Season 2 was released, confirming the continuation
The series will now debut sometime in 2027, with no exact date yet announced
Director Hiroshi Haraguchi replaces Ryota Itoh, and writer Yuka Yamada takes over script duties
Studio Doga Kobo remains the animation studio, with character designer Yuhei Murota returning
years_later_major_crunchyroll_anime_fina.why_it_matters: The confirmation gives fans a clear timeline and new creative staff, signaling continued investment in the franchise despite the delay.

though_i_am_an_inept_villainess_confirms.headline: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
though_i_am_an_inept_villainess_confirms.summary: The anime’s second cour, covering the “First Royal Outing” arc, is set for a January 2027 debut.
highlights: Second cour announced for January 2027 as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule
New main visual released alongside the announcement
Three new cast members added: Yuichi Nakamura, Shunichi Toki, and Chiaki Kobayashi
Series will continue streaming on Crunchyroll
though_i_am_an_inept_villainess_confirms.why_it_matters: The continuation expands the story’s intrigue and keeps the series accessible to international fans.

justice_league_unlimited_preview_bats_vs.headline: Justice League Unlimited #23
justice_league_unlimited_preview_bats_vs.summary: Justice League Unlimited #23 arrives in stores on September 23, 2026, concluding the Amnesty Saga with a Batman‑Lex Luthor showdown and a surprise new team leader.
highlights: The issue ends the Amnesty Saga as the Justice League is forced to imprison its own members
Batman and Lex Luthor face off in the finale, dubbed the "Money Brawl"
A surprise new leader for the Justice League is revealed in the issue
justice_league_unlimited_preview_bats_vs.why_it_matters: The climax resolves a major storyline and sets the direction for the team’s future leadership.

magic_knight_reiarth_pv2.headline: 魔法騎士レイアース (新作テレビアニメ)
magic_knight_reiarth_pv2.summary: 新作テレビアニメ『魔法騎士レイアース』の追加キャストとして能登麻美子、村瀬歩、上田瞳、安元洋貴が発表された。
highlights: 能登麻美子がアルシオーネ役、村瀬歩がアスコット役、上田瞳がカルディナ役、安元洋貴がラファーガ役を担当
PV第2弾とオープニング・エンディングテーマが同時に公開された
放送は10月7日からテレビ朝日系IMAnimation W枠で2クール連続で開始
原作はCLAMPの1993‑1995年連載作品で、1994年アニメ放送から30周年記念で制作
magic_knight_reiarth_pv2.why_it_matters: 追加キャストと新PVの公開は、30周年記念リメイクへの期待感を高め、シリーズ復活をファンに示す重要な情報です。

superman_preview_not_your_daddy_s_zod_bu.headline: Superman #42
superman_preview_not_your_daddy_s_zod_bu.summary: Superman #42 arrives in stores on September 23, 2026, continuing the Kingdom of Zod storyline into its eighth part.
highlights: Superman, Supergirl, and Lois Lane reunite the Super-Force for a desperate plan to restore order to the Kryptonite Kingdom
Zod and Ursa oppose the heroes, with a version of Zod that may surprise readers
The issue is part of the Kingdom of Zod crossover that began in August 2026
Multiple variant covers are available, including art by Daniel Sampere, Marcio Takara, Christian Ward, Mark Spears, and Jose Ladronn
superman_preview_not_your_daddy_s_zod_bu.why_it_matters: The issue caps the eight‑part Kingdom of Zod arc, a major crossover that brings together DC’s Super‑Family against a classic villain.

lanterns_sinestro_villain_2026.headline: Lanterns
lanterns_sinestro_villain_2026.summary: The DCU series Lanterns reveals that Sinestro has escaped prison, setting up a major villain storyline for the final episodes.
highlights: Ulrich Thomsen’s Sinestro appears in two episodes and is confirmed to have escaped from a space prison
Guy Gardner, played by Nathan Fillion, returns and reveals the Sinestro escape in the latest episode
A mid‑season trailer teases Sinestro speaking about fear and hints at the formation of a Sinestro Corps
The series hints at possible plans to revive Hal Jordan, potentially tying into future Sinestro Corps storylines
lanterns_sinestro_villain_2026.why_it_matters: Sinestro’s escape could launch the Sinestro Corps in the DCU and reshape the Green Lantern mythos for future seasons.

bride_the_barrier_master_tv_anime_reveal.headline: Bride of the Barrier Master TV Anime Cast Reveal
bride_the_barrier_master_tv_anime_reveal.summary: Kadokawa unveiled five new cast members for the upcoming Bride of the Barrier Master anime and confirmed its Netflix streaming.
highlights: Kanon Takao joins as Hazuki Ichise, Hana's twin sister
M.A.O is cast as Miyabi, a human‑form shikigami
The series is directed by Tōru Kitahata at studio TROYCA
Netflix will stream the series internationally
bride_the_barrier_master_tv_anime_reveal.why_it_matters: The expanded cast adds prominent voice talent and secures global streaming on Netflix, boosting the series' visibility.

the_dcu_batman_gets_namedropped_lanterns.headline: The Brave and the Bold (DCU Batman Film)
the_dcu_batman_gets_namedropped_lanterns.summary: James Gunn confirmed a DCU Batman film titled The Brave and the Bold, but no casting or release details have been announced yet.
highlights: James Gunn confirmed the existence of a DCU Batman feature film called The Brave and the Bold
The film is part of the newly outlined DCU slate announced by DC Studios
Batman has already appeared in the animated series Creature Commandos, but no actor has been cast for the live‑action role
the_dcu_batman_gets_namedropped_lanterns.why_it_matters: The film will be the first live‑action DCU portrayal of Batman, shaping the tone for the new shared universe

ikimonogakari_releases_goodbye_lara_anim.headline: Goodbye, Lara
ikimonogakari_releases_goodbye_lara_anim.summary: Japanese pop duo Ikimonogakari released a memorial music video for the opening theme of the anime Goodbye, Lara alongside the series' final episode.
highlights: The memorial video compiles memorable scenes and lines from the series and was posted on Ikimonogakari’s official YouTube channel
The anime aired 12 episodes from July 5 to September 21, 2026, directed by Takushi Koide at Kinema Citrus
The CD single of "Sayonara Lara" released on August 26, 2026 reached #32 on Oricon’s weekly single chart
Crunchyroll streamed the series worldwide (excluding Japan and China)
ikimonogakari_releases_goodbye_lara_anim.why_it_matters: The video marks the conclusion of the series and highlights the collaboration between the anime and its musical artist, offering fans a final commemorative piece.

a_major_green_lantern_character_official.headline: Carol Ferris Debuts in DCU’s “Lanterns”
a_major_green_lantern_character_official.summary: Amie MacKenzie appears as Carol Ferris in the latest episode of the DCU series Lanterns, marking the character’s first live‑action appearance in the franchise.
highlights: Amie MacKenzie, known for Better Call Saul and Monster, portrays Carol Ferris in Lanterns
The scene occurs during Hal Jordan’s funeral, hinting at a past relationship between Ferris and Jordan
John Stewart recognizes Ferris immediately, confirming her significance in the DCU storyline
a_major_green_lantern_character_official.why_it_matters: Ferris’s introduction expands the Lanterns roster and signals potential future storylines for the Green Lantern mythos in the DCU.

the_acolyte_was_going_feature_a_very_con.headline: The Acolyte Season 2 Controversial Scene Report
the_acolyte_was_going_feature_a_very_con.summary: Reported sources claim Season 2 of Disney+’s Star Wars: The Acolyte was set to include a metaphysical “sex” scene involving Osha and Qimir.
highlights: Knight Media reported the planned scene would involve a Force‑linked meditation tank rather than explicit visuals
The scene was described as a metaphysical threesome, likened to a non‑conventional “Avatar‑style” encounter
Showrunner Leslye Headland allegedly confirmed the intent to explore seduction themes through the Dark Side
the_acolyte_was_going_feature_a_very_con.why_it_matters: If true, it would mark the first overt romantic/sexual depiction in the Star Wars live‑action universe, challenging the franchise’s long‑standing PG standards.

doll_girl_s_atomic_age_debut_doll_man_au.headline: Doll Man #37 (Quality, 1951) – First Appearance of Doll Girl – Up for Auction
doll_girl_s_atomic_age_debut_doll_man_au.summary: Quality’s Doll Man #37, featuring Doll Girl’s atomic‑age debut, is being offered at the September 24‑26, 2026 Comic Books Signature Auction.
highlights: Doll Girl’s first appearance appears in Doll Man #37 (December 1951) where Martha Roberts gains lasting shrinking powers
The issue’s script was completed in May 1951, less than four months after the Nevada atomic test began
CGC lists only 52 universal copies, with three graded 6.5 and six higher, making it a rare key issue
The comic will be auctioned at Comic Books Signature Auction #7469 from September 24‑26, 2026
doll_girl_s_atomic_age_debut_doll_man_au.why_it_matters: The issue marks a historically significant debut tying Golden Age superhero storytelling to early Cold‑War atomic anxieties, and its scarcity makes it a prized collector’s item.

clayface_horror_movie_dc.headline: Clayface: Celebrity Dirt
clayface_horror_movie_dc.summary: DC announced a six‑issue noir horror miniseries starring Basil Karlo that blends body‑horror with Hollywood satire.
highlights: The series is written by horror author Jude Ellison S. Doyle with art by Fran Galán and colors by Patricio Delpeche
It launches on July 8 2026 as a six‑issue miniseries priced at $3.99 for the main cover
The story explores Basil Karlo’s fame‑obsessed psyche and introduces a doppelgänger who has stolen his identity
Variant covers are provided by Mike Del Mundo and Dave Johnson
clayface_horror_movie_dc.why_it_matters: It expands Clayface’s mythos with a fresh horror‑driven take that could influence future DC film and TV adaptations.

wolverine_28_release_2026_09_23.headline: Wolverine #28 (2020)
wolverine_28_release_2026_09_23.summary: Wolverine #28 arrives in stores on September 23, 2026, featuring Logan with mismatched adamantium‑and‑bone claws facing a pivotal decision in Dallas.
highlights: Logan is reforged with mismatched adamantium‑and‑bone claws
The issue sees Logan teaming up with Forge in Dallas amid a security breach and a red‑sports‑car chase
Written by Saladin Ahmed, art by Martín Cóccolo, cover by Dan Panosian
Available in multiple variants, including Paulo Siqueira, Terry Dodson, and DiazAlpizar covers
wolverine_28_release_2026_09_23.why_it_matters: The story continues the "Reforged" arc, promising a major character shift for Wolverine that could impact future X‑Men narratives.

avengers_endgame_encore_trailer_2026_09_.headline: Avengers Endgame: Encore
avengers_endgame_encore_trailer_2026_09_.summary: Marvel Studios is re‑releasing Avengers Endgame on September 25 2026 with a new trailer and four minutes of added footage that tie into the upcoming Avengers Doomsday.
highlights: The re‑release will debut in IMAX and Infinity Vision premium formats
A 21‑second trailer showcases iconic battle moments and the expanded footage
Four minutes of new footage are added to establish a link to Avengers Doomsday
The Russo brothers emphasize that seeing the Encore version is required before the December 18 2026 Doomsday release
avengers_endgame_encore_trailer_2026_09_.why_it_matters: The added scenes provide essential narrative setup for the next MCU installment, Avengers Doomsday.

bride_of_the_barrier_master_trailer_jan2.headline: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider‑Man Season 2 Prequel Comic
bride_of_the_barrier_master_trailer_jan2.summary: Marvel Comics will publish a four‑issue prequel comic for season 2 of the animated series, debuting with issue #1 on December 9, 2026.
highlights: Writer Christos Gage and artist Eric Gapstur return, having created the prequel for season 1 in 2024
The comic picks up after the season 1 finale where Norman Osborn obtained a symbiote sample
Issue #1 features a main cover by Leonardo Romero and variant covers by Luciano Vecchio and David Baldeón
The prequel is positioned as part of the show’s continuity ahead of the season’s January 2027 premiere
bride_of_the_barrier_master_trailer_jan2.why_it_matters: The comic expands the series’ storyline, giving fans deeper context before the new season launches on Disney+.

apocalypse_z_new_world_officially_brings.headline: Apocalypse Hotel
apocalypse_z_new_world_officially_brings.summary: The original TV anime Apocalypse Hotel will debut in April 2025, with a new trailer revealing additional cast members and staff details.
highlights: The series is directed by Kana Shundo at CygamesPictures with CyberAgent producing
Series composition is by Shigeru Murakoshi and character designs by Natsuki Yokoyama
Eight new cast members were announced, including Sumire Morohoshi and Hiroyuki Kinoshita
The anime is set to premiere on April 8, 2025 in Japan
apocalypse_z_new_world_officially_brings.why_it_matters: It marks a high‑profile original anime from CygamesPictures, expanding the post‑apocalyptic genre with a notable creative team.

grand_blue_visual_major_trailer_pv_with_.headline: Grand Blue Season 4
grand_blue_visual_major_trailer_pv_with_.summary: Grand Blue Season 4 was officially announced right after the third season finale.
highlights: Shinji Takamatsu returns as director, scriptwriter, and sound director
Animation will be handled by studios ZERO‑G and Liber
New teaser visual reveals Chisa Kotegawa, Aina Yoshiwara and Sakurako Busujima in swimsuits, hinting at a romantic rivalry
Returning voice cast includes Yuma Uchida as Iori Kitahara
grand_blue_visual_major_trailer_pv_with_.why_it_matters: The continuation confirms the series' ongoing popularity and keeps fans engaged with the same creative team.

new_attack_titan_reveals_disappointing_r.headline: Attack on Titan: Crimson Bow and Arrow (Screen X/4DX/Ultra 4DX Re-release)
new_attack_titan_reveals_disappointing_r.summary: A new trailer confirms the classic Attack on Titan compilation film will return to Japanese theatres in enhanced Screen X, 4DX, and Ultra 4DX formats on October 23, 2026.
highlights: The film, originally released in 2014 as a recap of Season 1, will be shown in Screen X, 4DX, and Ultra 4DX for the first time
The theatrical release is scheduled for October 23, 2026 in Japan, with no international release confirmed yet
The trailer showcases upgraded animation and sound quality compared to streaming versions
MAPPA, the studio behind the final anime season, is handling the re-release
new_attack_titan_reveals_disappointing_r.why_it_matters: It offers fans a high‑quality cinematic experience of the series’ early story, reinforcing Attack on Titan’s enduring popularity.

tarantino_s_oscar_winning_masterpiece_ge.headline: Golden Kamuy: Abashiri Prison Arc Live-Action Film
tarantino_s_oscar_winning_masterpiece_ge.summary: The sequel to the Golden Kamuy live‑action series will debut in Japanese theaters on March 13 2026.
highlights: The film continues the story from the 2024 live‑action series "Golden Kamuy: The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido"
Director Kenji Katagiri replaces Shigeaki Kubo, with Tsutomu Kuroiwa returning as screenwriter and Yutaka Yamada as composer
Cast includes Kento Yamazaki as Sugimoto and Anna Yamada as Asirpa among a large ensemble
A two‑part theatrical animation of the Sapporo Beer Factory arc is slated for October 2026, and a final anime season begins in January 2026
tarantino_s_oscar_winning_masterpiece_ge.why_it_matters: It expands the Golden Kamuy franchise across live‑action, animation, and TV, offering fans multiple formats to follow the story.

fleecs_and_seeley_reunite_the_princess_m.headline: The Princess Murders
fleecs_and_seeley_reunite_the_princess_m.summary: Image Comics announced the new creator‑owned series The Princess Murders by Tony Fleecs and Tim Seeley debuting in December.
highlights: The series blends fairy‑tale animation with giallo‑style slasher horror
Colors are by Brian Reber, known for Edge of Spider‑Verse
Issue #1 releases on December 9 with multiple variant covers, including a polybagged NSFW edition
fleecs_and_seeley_reunite_the_princess_m.why_it_matters: It reunites the acclaimed Fleecs‑Seeley team, promising a fresh, genre‑bending take on comic storytelling.

alice_queen_hearts_zenescope_december_so.headline: Wonderland Rebirth (One Shot)
alice_queen_hearts_zenescope_december_so.summary: Zenescope Comics' December 2026 solicit introduces Alice as the new Queen of Hearts in the one-shot "Wonderland Rebirth."
highlights: Alice becomes the Queen of Hearts of Wonderland, driving a dark plot to dominate the realm
Linnea, heir to the Queen of Spades, battles Alice to stop her plan
Written by Joe Brusha and Chas! Pangburn with art by Saint Yak, released December 16, 2026
alice_queen_hearts_zenescope_december_so.why_it_matters: The story reimagines classic Alice characters, offering fresh conflict for fans of Zenescope's Grimm Fairy Tales universe.

onepiece_elbaph_arc_finale_2026_trailer.headline: One Piece Episode 1180 Trailer – Elbaph Arc Finale
onepiece_elbaph_arc_finale_2026_trailer.summary: A teaser trailer for One Piece Episode 1180, the season finale of the Elbaph Arc, was released confirming its streaming debut on September 27 2026.
highlights: The trailer reveals the episode title “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’
It confirms streaming on Crunchyroll on September 27 2026, with Netflix following a week later
The episode caps the first phase of the Elbaph Arc, ending the 2026 seasonal batch of 26 episodes
The arc’s next phase is slated for 2027, though no exact date has been set
onepiece_elbaph_arc_finale_2026_trailer.why_it_matters: The trailer gives fans their first look at the climax of the current arc and sets the release schedule for the final episode of the year.

dc_batman_knightfall_quest_2026_trailer.headline: Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest
dc_batman_knightfall_quest_2026_trailer.summary: DC Studios released the first trailer for the R‑rated animated sequel Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest.
highlights: The trailer reveals Jean‑Paul Valley/Azrael taking up the Batman mantle after Bruce Wayne is broken by Bane
Jeff Wamester directs the film from a screenplay by Jeremy Adams
Anson Mount, Michael Mando, and Pablo Schreiber reprise their voice roles as Bruce Wayne, Bane, and Azrael respectively
dc_batman_knightfall_quest_2026_trailer.why_it_matters: The sequel continues the first film’s faithful adaptation of the iconic 1990s Knightfall saga, introducing a darker, more violent Batman for fans.

marvel_s_daredevil_born_again_officially.headline: Daredevil: Born Again
marvel_s_daredevil_born_again_officially.summary: Season 3 will be the final season of Daredevil: Born Again, ending the live‑action MCU series on Disney+.
highlights: The Hollywood Reporter confirmed Season 3 will be the last batch of episodes
Showrunner Dario Scardapane’s contract was not renewed, meaning he won’t helm the final season
Season 3 is expected to premiere in spring 2027, with promotion likely at NYCC in October
Returning Defenders characters—including Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and Elektra—are slated for the final season
marvel_s_daredevil_born_again_officially.why_it_matters: It marks the end of Marvel’s live‑action TV era on Disney+, reshaping the MCU’s television strategy.

demon_slayer_infinity_castle_confirms_hu.headline: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I
demon_slayer_infinity_castle_confirms_hu.summary: The first Infinity Castle film will stream on Hulu and Disney+ starting September 28, 2026.
highlights: Streaming debut on Hulu in the U.S. and Disney+ internationally
Features both Japanese and English audio tracks
Provides a convenient way to catch up on previous Demon Slayer arcs available on Hulu
demon_slayer_infinity_castle_confirms_hu.why_it_matters: Makes the blockbuster film easily accessible for fans who missed its theatrical run.

vengeance_sincerely_your_broken_saintess.headline: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess Season 2
vengeance_sincerely_your_broken_saintess.summary: A third teaser trailer and the main theme song for the second season have been released, confirming its October 1, 2026 debut in Japan.
highlights: The second season will premiere on October 1, 2026 in Japan
Theme song "Kareinaru Revenger" performed by Juice=Juice is featured in the new trailer
Saya Fukase takes over directing duties from Chisaki, with IMAGICA Infos / Imageworks Studio handling animation production
Returning main voice cast includes Asami Seto, Soma Saito, Momo Asakura, and others
vengeance_sincerely_your_broken_saintess.why_it_matters: The trailer reveals new plot directions and confirms the continuation of the popular fantasy romance series for fans awaiting the sequel.

street_fighter_live_action_trailer_2026_.headline: Street Fighter (Live‑Action Film)
street_fighter_live_action_trailer_2026_.summary: The new trailer showcases the film’s recreation of iconic game moves and reveals its ensemble cast.
highlights: Dragonlash Kick, Shoryuken, Spinning Bird Kick and many other signature attacks appear in the trailer
Kitao Sakurai directs the film starring Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken, and Callina Liang as Chun‑Li
The movie is scheduled to open in theaters on October 16, 2026
street_fighter_live_action_trailer_2026_.why_it_matters: Fans get a first look at how the beloved Capcom franchise’s combat style is translated to the big screen.

k_manga_no_clipping_my_way_supremacy_man.headline: No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy Manga added to K Manga
k_manga_no_clipping_my_way_supremacy_man.summary: Kodansha's K Manga platform announced it will simulpub Yui Hata's manga adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa's No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy.
highlights: The manga will be added as a simulpub title on K Manga
The story follows Henri, a weak boy who uses the "Evade" skill to bypass labyrinth walls for rewards
The original web novel debuted on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in February 2021 and light novels launched in June 2022
The manga previously ran in Shōnen Magazine R and moved to Magazine Pocket before its 12th volume release on July 9
k_manga_no_clipping_my_way_supremacy_man.why_it_matters: The addition expands K Manga's catalog with a popular web‑novel adaptation, giving fans immediate access to new chapters.

netflix_s_live_action_quiztopia_series_u.headline: Quiztopia Live-Action Series
netflix_s_live_action_quiztopia_series_u.summary: Netflix will debut its eight‑episode live‑action adaptation of the 1993‑1995 manga "Kokumin Quiz" on December 17, 2026.
highlights: Teaser trailer and expanded cast of 16 actors were revealed, including Takayuki Yamada as host KK
Directed by Teruyuki Yoshida, who also co‑writes the script with Maggy
The series will premiere globally on Netflix, with a full‑season drop on December 17, 2026
netflix_s_live_action_quiztopia_series_u.why_it_matters: It brings a cult 1990s manga to a worldwide audience, marking one of the most ambitious dystopian live‑action projects for Netflix.

akira_failing_love_manga_circulation_glo.headline: Akira Failing in Love
akira_failing_love_manga_circulation_glo.summary: Shinta Harekawa's Akira Failing in Love manga has surpassed 1 million copies in circulation worldwide.
highlights: Over 1 million copies in circulation globally as announced in Weekly Shonen Sunday combined issue 42/43 on September 16, 2026
Viz Media released the fourth English volume on September 8, 2026
The series debuted in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024 and has reached its eighth Japanese volume
The manga’s success highlights strong international demand for new shōnen romance titles
akira_failing_love_manga_circulation_glo.why_it_matters: Reaching the million‑copy milestone signals significant global popularity for a relatively new shōnen romance series.

lanterns_just_revealed_how_the_dcu_is_re.headline: Lanterns (2026)
lanterns_just_revealed_how_the_dcu_is_re.summary: Episode 6 of the HBO series Lanterns deepens the DCU tie‑ins by showing John Stewart’s new role as an architect designing panic‑room shelters referencing recent DC movies.
highlights: Episode 6 “Bad Optics” reveals John Stewart has become a renowned architect building city‑wide panic‑room networks
The episode directly references James Gunn’s Superman (dimensional rift in Metropolis) and The Suicide Squad (Starro threat)
Lanterns continues its 2026 timeline, ten years after the Rushville battle that made Green Lanterns pariahs
The series airs on HBO and streams on HBO Max, positioning it within the broader DCU continuity
lanterns_just_revealed_how_the_dcu_is_re.why_it_matters: The episode provides concrete narrative links between the Lanterns series and the expanding DCU film slate, answering fan questions about cross‑title continuity.

the_eye_collector_preview_no_windows_no_.headline: The Eye Collector #4
the_eye_collector_preview_no_windows_no_.summary: Image Comics' The Eye Collector #4, written by Jonathan Ball with art by Lyndon Radchenka and GMB Chomichuk, hits stores on September 23, 2026.
highlights: Written by Jonathan Ball and illustrated by Lyndon Radchenka and GMB Chomichuk
Features Clara confronting a windowless house filled with eyeballs to rescue her friend Nathan
Available in stores on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 for $3.99
the_eye_collector_preview_no_windows_no_.why_it_matters: The issue continues the series' unsettling horror narrative, appealing to fans of atmospheric indie comics.

Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.
The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.
The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.
Renowned Conan the Barbarian Illustrator Returns for New Omnibus Release
Titan and Penguin Random House's listing for the Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 promises unseen bonus material, a section of "rarely seen artwork" as well as an all-new introduction from Conan comics legend, Gary Kwapisz. Known for his detailed artwork that brought some of Conan's most savage scenes to life, Kwapisz worked not only on The Savage Sword of Conan but also Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

Yuzuki Tamukai as Azuha, Hana's shikigami that rests on her hair like an ornament
Taihi Kimura as Aoi, a shikigami in human form created by Hana
M.A.O as Miyabi, another shikigami in human form created by Hana

In the trailer, Azrael dishes out ruthless, brutal, violent justice to criminals, first in Batman's traditional cape and cowl before transitioning to a suit of Batman armor. Check out the trailer below.

Harekawa launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2024, and the eighth volume on September 16. Viz Media published the manga's fourth volume on September 8.
Kadokawa published one compiled book volume of Senpai, This Can't Be Love! in July 2019. Yen Pressreleased the manga in English in June 2024.
Kadokawa published the first volume of Sempai! Danjite Koi de wa! Brush up sequel manga in September 2020, and the second volume in May 2023. Yen Press released the sequel manga's first volume in December 2024.
Harekawa launched the Three Exorcism Siblings (Tengu Barai no San Kyōdai) manga in Coamix's Web Comic Zenyon in 2021. Coamix published the manga's first volume in 2022, and the seventh and final volume in September 2023. Titan Comicslicensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on July 28.
